candidates.change_summary: Change the overflow check to always revert by replacing the require condition with false.
Replace the assignment to acc.balance with acc.balance = msg.value so the balance overwrites instead of accumulating.
Remove the unlock time condition so it always sets unlockTime to _unlockTime, ignoring block.timestamp.
Replace the balance addition with a subtraction so the balance decreases by msg.value.
Delete the line that adds msg.value to acc.balance, leaving the balance unchanged.
Delete the unlockTime assignment so the unlock time remains its previous value.
Replace LogFile.AddMessage arguments to log a hardcoded address (address(0)) instead of msg.sender.
Replace LogFile.AddMessage value argument with 0 instead of msg.value.
Remove the block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime condition so Collect succeeds without waiting.
Remove the acc.balance>=MinSum condition so any positive balance can be collected.
Change acc.balance subtraction to addition, increasing balance on Collect.
Delete the entire if-condition body so balance is never reduced and no ETH is sent.
Change the ETH call to send _am to the contract itself instead of msg.sender, keeping balance unchanged externally.
